title.narrative: Increased capacities of constituents to develop and implement an integrated policy response on employment and social protection

description.narrative: In response to the ongoing refugee crisis in Armenia, the ILO will support the government and social partners in addressing decent work deficits and promoting formalisation of the labour market. Since the surge in labour supply generates pressure on working conditions, the ILO enhances efforts to safeguard workers’ rights and decent working conditions, paying particular attention to platform/gig workers and care workers. The ILO initiative also helps integrate displaced people into the labour market through strengthening public employment services and public works. In addition, it invigorates local economic development by building the capacity of local economic planners to improve local value chains to create more productive employment. For sustained impact of the interventions, the ILO bolsters the capacities of the constituents to promote formalisation of the economy and the labour market beyond the life of the initiative. Further, it facilitates tripartite policy dialogue on formalisation policies, regulations, and social protection reforms since formal policies and regulations guide actions of stakeholders and development partners. In social protection, the ILO's support will include a comparative analysis in view of ratification of the Convention 102 on minimum social security standards and provide technical assistance with the expectation of the social protection coverage extension to displaced and vulnerable populations.
